question: Which orders are still pending?
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

question: List all customers based in India.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'India'

question: Which products cost more than 100 dollars?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100

question: Show the customer accounts that are deactivated.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE is_active = FALSE

question: Which products have fewer than 50 units in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 50

question: Show all cancelled orders.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: Which suppliers have a lead time longer than 14 days?
gold_sql: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, country, lead_time_days FROM suppliers WHERE lead_time_days > 14

question: Show every review that gave a rating of 5.
gold_sql: SELECT review_id, product_id, customer_id, rating FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5

question: How many orders are there in each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: What is the average order value for each year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::INT AS order_year, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders GROUP BY order_year

question: How many customers are there in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: What is the total payment amount collected by each payment method?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method

question: How many products does each supplier provide?
gold_sql: SELECT supplier_id, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY supplier_id

question: What is the average product price in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category_id, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category_id

question: How many reviews were given at each rating value?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY rating

question: What are the highest and lowest order totals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(total_amount), 2) AS highest_order, ROUND(MIN(total_amount), 2) AS lowest_order FROM orders

question: Show the top 10 customers by total amount spent across all their orders.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10

question: List every product together with the name of its category.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

question: Which customers have placed a cancelled order?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

question: Show each product alongside the name of the supplier that provides it.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, s.supplier_name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id

question: What is the average review rating for each product, by product name?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name

question: For orders with an id between 1 and 20, show the payment method used for each.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, p.payment_method FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

question: Which customers have written at least one review?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN reviews r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: Which product categories have generated the most revenue from order line items?
gold_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Show the top 10 products by total units sold, along with their category name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY p.product_name, cat.category_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which suppliers' products have generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: What is the total completed payment revenue from customers in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(pay.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pay.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: List the 5 highest-rated products that have at least 3 reviews, including the country of their supplier.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, s.country, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY p.product_name, s.country HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5

question: For each product category, how many distinct customers have bought from it?
gold_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: Show total order revenue for each month of 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::DATE AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

question: Which orders were placed in the last quarter of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: Show the orders placed in the first half of 2023.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2023-07-01'

question: What was the total order revenue in the first quarter of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-04-01'

question: Who are our best customers?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(pay.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pay.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which products are underperforming?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold ASC

question: Show me month-over-month revenue growth.
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::DATE AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS growth FROM monthly ORDER BY month

question: Which customers are at risk of churning?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING MAX(o.order_date) < (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders) - INTERVAL '180 days' ORDER BY last_order_date

question: What is our profit margin by category?
gold_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)), 2) AS gross_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
